# descope_governance (Resource)

Manages the project's Agentic Governance Suite configuration. This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that these settings belong to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `auto_approval` (Boolean) Setting this to `true` approves access requests automatically instead of waiting for an admin to review them.
- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the Agentic Governance Suite has been set up for the project.
- `suite_disabled` (Boolean) Setting this to `true` turns off the Agentic Governance Suite for the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
